G1254.definition: δια-κωλεύω; to hinder, prevent: with accusative, Mat.3:14.†; (AS)

G1205.definition: adv., as pl. of δεῦρο, 1. (b), which see,  ; come on! come here! come!: with imperat., Mat.25:34 28:6, Jhn.4:29 21:12, Rev.19:17; with subjc., Mat.21:38, Mrk.12:7; before ὀπίσω, Mat.4:19, Mrk.1:17; πρός, Mat.11:28; εἰς, Mat.22:4, Mrk.6:31.†; (AS)

G1259.definition: δι-αλλάσσω; 1. to change, exchange. ; 2. to change enmity for friendship, to reconcile: pass., with dative of person(s), Mat.5:24. G1227.definition: δια-βλέπω ; 1. to took straight before one. ; 2. to see clearly: Mat.7:5, Mrk.8:25, Luk.6:42 (cf. διάβλεψις, Aq., Isa.61:1, for LXX ἀνάβ-).†; (AS)

G1276.definition: δια-περάω, -ῶ; to pass over, cross over: Mat.9:1; before ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, Mat.14:34, Mrk.6:53; εἰς, Mrk.5:21, Act.21:2; πρὸς ἡμᾶς, Luk.16:28.†; (AS)

G1209.definition: to receive, accept; 1. with accusative of thing(s), of taking or accepting what is offered: γράμματα, Luk.16:6, 7; id. in different sense, Act.28:21; ποτήριον, Luk.22:17; παιδίον (εἰς τ. ἀγκάλας), Luk.2:28; περικεφαλαίαν, μάχαιραν, Eph.6:17; ἐπιστολάς, Act.22:5; τ. βασιλείαν τ. Θεοῦ, Mrk.10:15, Luk.18:17; λογία ζῶντα, Act.7:38; εὐαγγέλιον, 2Co.11:4; τ. χάριν τ. Θεοῦ, 2Co.6:1; metaphorically, of mental acceptance…

G1299.definition: δια-τάσσω; to charge, give orders to, appoint, arrange, ordain: with dative, Mat.11:1, 1Co.9:14 16:1; before inf., Luk.8:55, Act.18:2. Mid., 1Co.7:17, Act.20:13; with accusative, 1Co.11:34; with dative, Tit.1:5; before inf., Act.7:44 24:23. Pass., τὸ διατεταγμένον, Luk.3:13, Act.23:31; τὰ διαταχθέντα, Luk.17:9-10; διαταγείς, Gal.3:19.†; (AS)

G1210.definition: to tie, bind, fasten; (1) with accusative of thing(s), before εἰς δεσμάς, Mat.13:30; of an ass, Mat.21:2, Mrk.11:2, 4 Luk.19:30. ; (2) with accusative of person(s), of swathing a dead body, ὀθονίοις, Jhn.19:40; δεδομένος τ. πόδας . . . κειρίαις (Bl., §34, 6; Kühner 3, iii, 125), Jhn.11:44; of binding with chains, ἀγγέλους, Rev.9:14; a demoniac, πέδαις κ. ἁλύσεσι, Mrk.5:3, 4; captives, Mat.12:29 14:3 22:13 27:2…

G1211.definition: consecutive co-ordinating particle with no exact equiv. in Eng., giving greater exactness and emphasis to the word or words to which it is attached; sometimes translatable as now therefore, then, verily, certainly. ; 1. With verbs: imperat., Act.6:3 (WH, mg.) 13:2, 1Co.6:20; hort. subjc., Luk.2:15, Act.15:36; indic., δή που (Τ, δήπου, which see), Heb.2:16. ; 2. With pronouns: ὃ δή, now this is he who, Mat.13:23.†…

G1285.definition: δια-σαφέω, -ῶ; (σαφής, clear),  ; to make clear, explain fully: with accusative of thing(s), dative of person(s), Mat.13:26 18:31.†; (AS)

G1295.definition: δια-σώζω; to bring safely through a danger: Luk.7:3, Act.27:43; before πρός, Act.23:24. Pass., to come safe through: Act.28:1; ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, Act.27:44; ἐκ τ. θαλάσσης, Act.28:4; δι᾽ ὕδατος, 1Pe.3:20; of sickness, to recover: Mat.14:36.†; (AS)

G1261.definition: δια-λογισμός, -οῦ, ὁ; (διαλογίζομαι)  ; a thought, reasoning, inward questioning: Mat.15:19, Mrk.7:21, Luk.2:35 5:22 6:8 9:46, 47 24:38, Rom.1:21 14:1, 1Co.3:20" (LXX), Php.2:14; κριταὶ δ. πονηρῶν, genitive of qual. (cf. Pro.12:5), Jas.2:4; χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ δ. (where perh. δ., like מְזִמָּה, in Ps 138(139):20, al., implies evil intention), 1Ti.2:8 (see Hort, in l.; cf. Cremer, 400).†; (AS)

G1252.definition: δια-κρίνω; 1. to separate, hence, to distinguish, discriminate, discern: μηδὲν δ., Act.11:12; οὐδὲν δ. μεταξύ, Act.15:9; σε, 1Co.4:7; τὸ σῶμα, 1Co.11:29. ; 2. to settle, decide, judge, arbitrate: Mat.16:3, 1Co.6:5 11:29 (ICC, in l.), ib. 31 14:29. Mid, and pass.; 1. to get a decision, contend, dispute: before πρός, Act.11:2; with dative (but see ICC, in l.), Ju 9; absol., Ju 22 (R,mg.). ; 2. Hellenistic (NT and…

G1260.definition: δια-λογίζομαι, depon.; 1. to balance accounts (Dem.). ; 2. to consider, reason (Isocr.): Luk.1:29 5:21; ἐν τ. καρδία, Mrk.2:6, 8, Luk.5:22; περί Luk.3:15; ἐν ἑαυτῷ (-οῖς), Mat.16:7-8, Mrk.2:8, Luk.12:17; πρὸς ἑ., Mrk.9:33 11:31, Luk.20:14; παρ᾽ ἑ., Mat.21:25 (ἐν ἑ., T, WH, mg.); πρὸς ἀλλήλους, Mrk.8:16; ὅτι, Mrk.8:17, Jhn.11:50, Rec. (DB, i, 611; Cremer, 400).†; (AS)

G1291.definition: δια-στελλω; 1. to divide, distinguish, define. ; 2. to command, charge expressly: pass., τὸ διαστελλόμενον, Heb.12:20. Mid., in late Gk. with same sense (so Ez, l.with; and al. in LXX; MM, see word); a. dative of person(s), Mrk.8:15, Act.15:24; before ἵνα, Mat.16:20, Mrk.5:43 7:36 9:9.†; (AS)

G1294.definition: δια-στρέφω; to distort, twist; metaphorically, to distort, pervert: Luk.23:2, Act.13:8, 10; διεστραμμένος, perverse: Mat.17:17, Luk.9:41, Act.20:30, Php.2:15.†; (AS)

G1270.definition: δια-νόημα, -τος, τό; (διανοέομαι, to think),  ; a thought: Luk.11:17.†; (AS)

G1234.definition: δια-γογγύζω; of a number, to murmur or mutter among themselves: Luk.15:2 19:7.†; (AS)

G1244.definition: δι-αιρέω, -ῶ; 1. to divide into parts, cut asunder. ; 2. to distribute: with accusative of thing(s), dative of person(s), Luk.15:12, 1Co.12:11.†; (AS)

G1241.definition: δια-ζώννυμι, (also -ννύω); to gird round: ἑαυτόν, Jhn.13:4; pass., ib. 13:5; mid., to gird oneself with: with accusative, Jhn.21:7.†; (AS)

G1258.definition: διά-λεκτος, -ου, ἡ; (διαλέγομαι),  ; 1. conversation, discourse, speech (Plat., Dem., al.). ; 2. As in Polyb. and later writers, the language or dialect of a particular country or district: Act.1:19 2:6, 8 21:40 22:2 26:14.†; (AS)

G1278.definition: δια-πονέω, -ῶ; to work out with labour. Pass., to be worn out, sore troubled: Mrk.14:4 (WH, mg.), Act.4:2 16:18.†; (AS)

G1268.definition: δια-νέμω; to distribute, divide: pass., to be spread about, Act.4:17.†; (AS)

G1282.definition: δια-πρίω; to saw asunder. Pass., metaphorically (vernacular?), EV, cut to the heart: Act.5:33; before τ. καρδίαις αὐτῶν, Act.7:54.†; (AS)
renderings: members of the Sanhedrin were enraged

G1262.definition: δια-λύω; to part asunder, dissolve; of an assembly, pass., to disperse: Act.5:36.†; (AS)

G1237.definition: δια-δέχομαι; to receive through another, receive in turn: Act.7:45 (RV, in their turn; see Field, Notes, 116).†; (AS)

I. 3465): Rom.13:2, Act.7:53, R, txt. (and see mg.; Page and EGT, in l; but…

G1289.definition: δια-σπείρω; to scatter abroad, disperse: Act.8:1, 4 11:19.†; (AS)

G1215.definition: (δῆμος, ἀγορεύω, to speak in the assembly),  ; to deliver an oration: Act.12:21.†; (AS)

(Att... λεώς)…

G1200.definition: δεσμο-φύλαξ, -κος, ὁ; (δεσμός, φύλαξ), ; a prison-keeper, gaoler: Act.16:23, 27, 36 (cf. ἀρχιδ-, Gen.39:21).†; (AS)

G1216.definition: Demetrius; 1. a silversmith, Act.19:24 38. ; 2. A Christian disciple, III Jn 12.†; (AS)

G1274.definition: δι-ανύω; 1. to accomplish fully, finish, complete: Act.21:7 (EV). ; 2. In late writers (Xen., al., Clem., I ad Cor., xxv, 3), to continue: Ac, l.with (Field, Notes, 134f.).†; (AS)

G1264.definition: δια-μάχομαι; 1. to struggle against. ; 2. In argument, to contend: Act.23:9.†; (AS)

G1231.definition: δια-γινώσκω; (see previous word),  ; 1. to distinguish, ascertain exactly: Act.23:15 ; 2. As Athen. law-term, to determine: τὰ καθ᾽ ὑμᾶς, your case, Act.24:22 (Cremer, 673).†; (AS)

G1251.definition: δι-ακούω; to hear through, hear fully; technically, to hear judicially (as De, l.with; of. Deiss., BS, 230): Act.23:35.†; (AS)

G1240.definition: διά-δοχος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ; (διαδέχομαι),  ; a successor: Act.24:27 (for usage in LXX and π. in sense of court official, see Deiss., BS, 115).†; (AS)

G1233.definition: διά-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ; (διαγιγνώσκω),  ; 1. a distinguishing, also as medical term. ; 2. As law-term (Lat. cognitio), determination, decision: Act.25:21 (Cremer, 674).†; (AS)

G1277.definition: to sail across , Thuc.; εἰς Αἴγιναν (Aristophanes Comicus): metaphorically, δ. βίον to make life's voyage , (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

G1206.definition: (δεύτερος), ; adj. with adverbial sense; on the second day: δευτεραῖοι ἤλθομεν, Act.28:13.†; (AS)

G1293.definition: δια-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ; (διαστέλλω),  ; 1. a separation. ; 2. a distinction, difference: Rom.3:22 10:12, 1Co.14:7.†; (AS)

G1253.definition: διά-κρισις, -εως, ἡ; (διακρίνω)  ; the act of judgment, discernment: Rom.14:1, 1Co.12:10, Heb.5:14.†; (AS)

G1213.definition: to make plain, declare: with accusative, 1Co.3:13, Col.1:8, Heb.9:8 12:27; with dative of person(s), 2Pe.1:14; with dative of person(s), before περί (pass.), 1Co.1:11; before εἰς, 1Pe.1:11.†; SYN.: ἐμφανίζω, to make manifest, render visible to the sight; δ. to render evident to the mind. (AS)

G1243.definition: δι-αίρεσις, -εως, ἡ; (διαιρέω),  ; 1. a distinction, diference. ; 2. a division, distribution: 1Co.12:4-6 (cf. διαιρέω; Cremer, 616).†; (AS)

G1214.definition: (perh. contracted from Δημήτριος), ; Demas, a companion of St. Paul: Col.4:14, Phm 24, 2Ti.4:10.†; (AS)

G1226.definition: δια-βεβαιόομαι, -οῦμαι ; to affirm confidently: Tit.3:8; before περί, 1Ti.1:7 (Cremer, 140).†; (AS)

G1236.definition: δι-άγω; 1. to carry over. ; 2. Of time, to pass: βίον, 1Ti.2:2; absol., to live, before ἐν, Tit.3:3.†; (AS)

G1217.definition: (δῆμος, ἔργον),  ; 1. one who works for the people. ; 2. Univ., an author, builder, maker; the maker of the world (Xen., Mem., I, 4, 9, al.), Heb.11:10.†; SYN.: κτίστης, creator, τεχνίτης, craftsman, designer. In He, l.with, τ. has reference to the plan, δ. to its execution. (AS)

G1297.definition: διά-ταγμα, -τος, τό; (διατάσσω),  ; an edict, mandate: Heb.11:23.†; (AS)

G1238.definition: (διαδέω, to bind round),  ; the band round the τιάρα of a Persian king; a diadem, the badge of royalty: Rev.12:3 13:1 19:12.†; SYN.: στέφανος, the badge of "victory, of valour, of nuptial joy, of festal gladness " (but see M, Th., i, 219; cf. DB, i, 530, 604). (AS)
